name: Mars

figure.caption: Mars: agent task topology — tasks coloured by lifecycle state, edges are blocker dependencies.

body: A local AFK agent swarm for software work. You give it a goal and it builds a web of tasks, figures out the order they have to run in, and executes the whole graph autonomously: writing code, recovering from failures, and chaining the follow-up work without a human in the loop. The topology view lets you watch the dependency web plan and run itself in real time.

Coordinating many agents so they do the right work in the right order, and recover when a step fails, is a hard orchestration problem — Mars handles scheduling, dependency resolution, and failure recovery autonomously.
proofStatement: a private product, so there is no public link. The diagram above mirrors the live topology view — nodes are tasks, edges are blocker dependencies, colours are lifecycle state, and the failed branch shows a recovered task picked up by a follow-up agent.
